hypothesis: The causal topology of intraday return signs, including transition asymmetry, run persistence, sign entropy, and jump concentration, can distinguish persistent price discovery from exhausted paths without using volume, breadth, dispersion, or state-difference factors.
version_contract: ten economically distinct causal sign-sequence representations times ten decision-and-exit schedules; each version ranks five training thresholds and two causal volatility targets

fit_contract.causality: all sign-sequence inputs end at the declared decision bar
